Umbra Rake.name: Umbra Rake
Umbra Rake.description: The shadow lashes out at a target within its reach and rakes them with its claws for slashing damage, or slams them with a fist for bludgeoning damage that knocks them flat. Held back, it only shoves them to the ground and leaves no wound. In darkness the blow lands harder; in bright light it barely stings. Strain: light.
